Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences : Profile

The Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences was established in 2024 under
the School of Pharmaceutical and Biological Sciences with the objective
of delivering high-quality education and research in the field of
pharmacy. The department commenced its Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.)
program in the academic year 2024–2025, approved from the Pharmacy
Council of India (PCI), New Delhi. It is well equipped with modern
laboratories, well-furnished classrooms, and seminar halls to facilitate
an effective teaching–learning environment.

The department is dedicated to academic excellence and the promotion of
advanced research across multiple pharmaceutical domains. It provides
extensive training in patient counseling, drug information services,
medication reconciliation, health screening, community outreach
programs, health awareness initiatives, medical camps, industrial
training, and educational tours.

The laboratories are equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure to
support academic learning and research activities. These facilities
enable students to gain practical exposure to contemporary industrial
practices and modern research methodologies in Pharmaceutical Sciences.

The department is supported by experienced and committed faculty members
who play a pivotal role in strengthening students’ technical knowledge,
professional skills, and research aptitude, thereby preparing them for
successful careers in industry and research organizations.

A key highlight is strong focus on experiential and hands-on learning.
Students actively participate in real-time research projects under the
guidance of faculty members, which helps them develop critical thinking,
problem-solving abilities, and practical competencies required to
address emerging global healthcare challenges.
